threshold_definitions.X: Maximum physical-line span for one multiline call before it becomes a semantic review candidate.
threshold_definitions.Y_assignment_span: Maximum physical-line span for one multiline assignment before it becomes a semantic review candidate.
threshold_definitions.Y_simple_run_length: Maximum statement count for one blank-line-delimited run of simple assignments before it becomes a semantic review candidate.
threshold_definitions.Z: Maximum attached preparatory physical-line count allowed for a compact transfer in a primary guard, loop, or match-case body.
